attack_model.missing_read_strategy: replay the ordinary full-memory evaluator from iteration zero to the read point
attack_model.output_requirement: all paired digest-sequence commitments and digest xors must match
attack_model.replay_workspace: one full declared scratchpad allocated transiently for each missing read
attack_model.attacker_optimization: exact-output correctness and work-accounting baseline; intentionally not memory-bounded

why_not_decisive: peak scratch allocation is 150% of the declared scratchpad rather than 50%
resident memory and allocator overhead are not measured
replay starts from iteration zero rather than using optimized bounded checkpoints
shared runners do not control memory bandwidth, power, temperature, or competing load
